# Laby Client addon: headtool

- Namespace `mintmc`, main package `com.magnus.mintmc`, Laby Client release channel `production`. Minecraft versions: `net.labymod.minecraft-versions` (or `supported_versions`) in `gradle.properties`.
- `api/`: this addon's public API for other addons, no Minecraft code.
- `core/`: the addon itself (main class with `@AddonMain`, config, listeners, activities). Translations in `core/src/main/resources/assets/mintmc/i18n/en_us.json`, themes and LSS in `core/src/main/resources/assets/mintmc/themes/`.
- `game-runner/`: Minecraft version specific code in `game-runner/src/v<version>/java/com/magnus/mintmc/v<version>/`, mixins in its `mixins` package. Code for all 1.16.5+ versions can live once in `game-runner/src/shared/java/com/magnus/mintmc/shared/` (skill `laby-version-specific`).
- Only `net.labymod.api` is the API. Never use `net.labymod.core` classes in the addon.

## Commands

- Run the dev client: `./gradlew :game-runner:client_v<version>`, or the IDE run config `client v<version>`.
- Check against the store guidelines: `./gradlew checkAddon`. Run it after every change; errors fail the task.
- Release jar: `./gradlew build createReleaseJar`, output `build/libs/*-release.jar`.
- After updating LabyGradle or changing the release channel: `./gradlew setupMcpServer`, then restart the agent.

## Tools

MCP server `minecraft-sources`:
- `laby_find_class`, `laby_find_implementations`, `laby_class_info`, `laby_read_source`, `laby_search_source`, `laby_find_references`: the Laby Client api and core of this addon's channel. Look up classes and signatures here instead of guessing them.
- `laby_wiki_search`, `laby_wiki_read`: the developer wiki (dev.labymod.net) for concepts and how-tos.
- `check_addon`: the same check as `./gradlew checkAddon`. `check_mixins`: mixin targets and access wideners against every configured Minecraft version.
- `read_source`, `find_method`, `get_class_info`, `symbol_availability` and more: decompiled Minecraft per version.

MCP server `laby-client`: drives the running dev client (state, screenshots, input, logs).

Skills: `laby-addon-api`, `laby-addon-guidelines`, `laby-version-specific`, `laby-client-testing`.

## Workflow

1. Find the API with `laby_find_class` or `laby_wiki_search` before writing code.
2. Put user-visible text in `en_us.json` and read it with `Component.translatable`.
3. After a change: build, run `check_addon`, and `check_mixins` when mixins or access wideners changed.
4. Verify the change in the running client with the `laby-client` tools.
